rationale.automation-bias: Studies how trust and flow lead developers to approve unread code.
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Documents how large AI codebases make manual review tedious and unscalable.
rationale.quality-debt: Empirical reports of vibe coding causing technical debt and unmaintainable code.
rationale.ai-review: Documents practitioners asking AI models to review and audit generated code.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Documents practitioners writing or generating tests to verify AI outputs.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Documents practitioners asking AI to log its changes for version control.
rationale.survey-input: Substantive empirical findings on developer adoption, preferences, and pain points.
rationale.agentic: Vibe coding involves conversational generation at the PR or artifact level.
rationale.steering: Documents practitioners using persona prompts and context rules to guide generation.
rationale.risk-security: Reports an empirical result about it: users generated plain-text passwords.
rationale.risk-quality: Reports an empirical result about it: users experienced severe technical debt.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Reports an empirical result about it: users reported addiction and over-reliance.
rationale.method-mining: Analyzed 134 Reddit and LinkedIn posts and over 5,000 comments.
rationale.method-self-report: Conducted 11 semi-structured developer interviews about their experiences.
